note: Analyst reading of the news, written by the weekly agent from logged events. Not data. Replace every week.
headline: Trump is openly weighing a return to war: 'do I make a deal with them, or do I finish them off?' (Oct 25), after saying the US 'may do another little Epic Fury' (Oct 23). He also said 'There will not be a strike today' (#122, #126).

The US is thinning out in the Gulf: non-emergency diplomats ordered out of Saudi Arabia (Oct 21), staff cuts in Jordan, Lebanon, Qatar and the UAE (Oct 23), and officials say the military is quietly reducing its footprint (#120). A US intelligence memo warns of Iranian plots against US personnel (#124).

Shipping: UKMTO confirmed two tanker hits (Oct 20 off Iraq, Oct 21 off Oman, no one hurt) (#117, #118). The IRGC claims nine more hits Oct 22-23 and threatens US bases; Trump calls them 'fake hits' (#121, #123). Brent oil rose to about $117.

Talks: no deal. Iran says messages still go through intermediaries and it is open to talks under the June interim deal (#125, #127). Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish officials are in Tehran on Oct 26; the US is not part of that meeting (#128).
New sanctions on Oct 21 (shadow fleet, #119). No US strike on Iran and no Iranian attack on US forces was found this week.
